question: Which three addresses sent the most USDC (largest total Transfer(address,address,uint256) value by from) during the 24 hours ending at the latest finalized block when requested on chain 8453, from logs emitted by 0x833589fcd6edb6e08f4c7c32d4f71b54bda02913? Rank by the summed value in raw USDC units, highest first, ties by ascending address, positive totals only.

definitions.window: The observation covers the last 24 hours ending at the latest finalized block available when requested. Resolve this once to inclusive fromBlock and toBlock; state reads use toBlock.
definitions.missing: If any required data is unavailable, inconsistent or incomplete, report inability; do not encode unknown as zero, false or an empty list.
definitions.event: event Transfer(address indexed from,address indexed to,uint256 value)
definitions.metric: log-rank over logs emitted by 0x833589fcd6edb6e08f4c7c32d4f71b54bda02913 only: key indexed from, sum value in raw token units. Exclude key 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000. Keep only positive totals.
definitions.ordering: Descending summed value; ties by ascending numeric 20-byte address. Return up to 3 unique entries; fewer when fewer eligible keys; empty only for a complete zero-activity set.
